stories.short: NIPSCO Minority Interest Blackstone Capital Commitment
stories.name_fr: Engagement de capital Blackstone pour intérêts minoritaires de NIPSCO
stories.name_en: NIPSCO Minority Interest Blackstone Capital Commitment
stories.explanation: Additional mandatory capital contribution amount committed by Blackstone affiliates under amended LLC agreement
stories.signal: Increased Blackstone capital commitment to NIPSCO Holdings II for long-term infrastructure investment and data center service expansion
stories.description: In October 2025, the Amended LLC Agreement increased additional mandatory capital contributions required from Blackstone affiliates by $175 million over a seven-year period, backed by an Equity Commitment Letter
